## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL regime; Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: weak sector breadth and a major divergence among large caps (MSFT, AMZN, CAT showing 1W/1M mismatch) support a restrained posture; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leading on select names: AAPL (1W: +4.05% | 1M: +15.58%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.66% | 1M: +14.92%) ABOVE TREND, CSCO (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +23.31%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare and Consumer Staples also showing pockets of strength: UNH (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +27.68%) ABOVE TREND, CVS (1W: +12.95% | 1M: +27.51%) ABOVE TREND, MNST (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +14.47%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities, Financials and Consumer Discretionary lag on a 1W basis with clear downside concentration; Utilities examples: VST (1W: -9.91% | 1M: -13.03%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -14.84% | 1M: -7.32%) BELOW TREND. Financials and Consumer Discretionary: JPM (1W: -4.65% | 1M: -3.49%) BELOW TREND, RCL (1W: -7.97% | 1M: -6.16%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PANW (1W: +24.01% | 1M: +40.97%) ABOVE TREND, CVS (1W: +12.95% | 1M: +27.51%) ABOVE TREND, F (1W: +12.91% | 1M: +8.11%) ABOVE TREND, TSLA (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +22.26%) ABOVE TREND, MNST (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +14.47%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ROST (1W: -7.49% | 1M: -5.16%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -7.90% | 1M: -14.40%) BELOW TREND, RCL (1W: -7.97% | 1M: -6.16%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -8.04% | 1M: -9.49%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -3.19%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Consumer Discretionary, Financials and select Tech names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: PANW (1W: +24.01% | 1M: +40.97%) ABOVE TREND, CSCO (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +23.31%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +10.70% | 1M: +60.47%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.30% | 1M: -1.41%) RECOVERY — note FCX is a 1W/1M divergence. Major divergence among mega-caps (MSFT CORRECTION, AMZN CORRECTION, CAT CORRECTION) tempers momentum reading.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed with pockets of strength and short-term dispersion: AAPL (1W: +4.05% | 1M: +15.58%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.66% | 1M: +14.92%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: -2.11% | 1M: +3.08%) CORRECTION, META (1W: +0.61% | 1M: -6.92%) RECOVERY. Sector 1W/1M performance is positive overall but internal divergence suggests selective exposure.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials remain weak on the week with mixed internals: JPM (1W: -4.65% | 1M: -3.49%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -8.04% | 1M: -9.49%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: +0.68% | 1M: +3.08%) ABOVE TREND. Continued caution warranted given sector-level underperformance driving part of the NEUTRAL regime.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare shows leadership pockets and defensive elements: UNH (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +27.68%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +2.91% | 1M: +10.11%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +2.58% | 1M: -4.03%) RECOVERY. Sector breadth is mixed; watch earnings/news sensitivity in several names.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Maintain a neutral, selective posture: favor pockets of strength (PANW, UNH, NVDA) and reduce exposure to clearly broken names (WFC, CRM, SHOP) until dispersion resolves. Style: mixed / no clear leadership given breadth and mega-cap divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: PANW (1W: +24.01% | 1M: +40.97%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +10.70% | 1M: +60.47%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +27.68%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: WFC (1W: -8.04% | 1M: -9.49%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -3.19%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -14.84% | 1M: -7.32%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology and Healthcare for momentum and news-driven moves (Tech showing strong 1M gains despite dispersion). BEARISH: Financials and Utilities after weak 1W performance; breadth is negative in these groups and may pressure cyclicals.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA continuation above recent swing highs to confirm tech momentum; AAPL support on pullbacks for fresh entries while CORRECTION names (MSFT, AMZN) need confirmation of trend resumption. Monitor sentiment catalysts (earnings, upgrades) that would flip RECOVERY names back to ABOVE TREND or push CORRECTION names lower.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
CSCO (+60): CSCO (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +23.31%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price confirming after a strong print. UNH (+50): UNH (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +27.68%) ABOVE TREND — Goldman addition confirms accumulation. F (+50): F (1W: +12.91% | 1M: +8.11%) ABOVE TREND — news-driven move confirming price action.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
CVX (-50): CVX (1W: +0.45% | 1M: -0.55%) RECOVERY — negative analyst chatter contrasts with a short-term bounce, a divergence to monitor. (Other heavy negative headlines in the feed: ISRG -85, GILD -55, SYK -55—flagged as material; timeframes not in the current extract, monitor if included in portfolios.)

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +24.01% | 1M: +40.97%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +27.68%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.66% | 1M: +14.92%) showing relative strength. Key risk: major mega-cap divergence (MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -2.11% | 1M: +3.08%), AMZN CORRECTION (1W: -1.77% | 1M: +8.48%)) and sentiment/price mismatches like CVX (-50) vs RECOVERY — watch for confirmation before re-risking.
